notes.text: The checked base reports Huna bar Ammi with the Pedat–Yochanan chain. Heilprin's emendation is a separate reading.
The pointed entry explicitly states the competing Ein Yaakov and Gemara names.
The emendation remains Heilprin's judgment. The direct Bavli gives Huna bar Ammi. The other entry attributes Chanan bar Ammi to an Ein Yaakov witness; the Glick chapter did not confirm that form.
